feature: Sign up END TO END: receive the real confirmation email and open the link
promise: 'Check your email to confirm your account.' — the customer receives a confirmation email and can activate the account
account: accounts A and B (Gmail plus-aliases of the connected inbox derekbowencorp@gmail.com)

actions: 06:48:37Z sign up account A → POST /auth/v1/signup 200, confirmation_sent_at set
06:51:51Z submit support ticket with A's email → 'We'll email you shortly'
poll Gmail (in:anywhere, i.e. inbox + spam + all folders) at +3, +8, +13, +33, +42 min
expected: Confirmation email in the inbox (or spam) within minutes; provider message id visible
actual: NO email of any kind from founders.click reached Gmail after 42 minutes (three separate sends to two aliases: 2 confirmations + 1 ticket receipt). Gmail received unrelated mail normally in the same window (LinkedIn 05:54Z). Same inbox shows ZERO founders.click messages in the last 60 days including the welcome email for the founder's own workspace. The Outlook account derekcbowen@outlook.com is likewise still unconfirmed 23h after its confirmation resend (08:38Z 09-01). The hook returns 200 even when EmailIt fails, by design, so the signup UI reports success.
customer_impact: Every new customer is told to check their email and nothing arrives. No account can be activated through the product. Password reset and support-ticket receipts are on the same path.
repro: sign up with any Gmail address
wait — no email arrives in inbox or spam

extra.supporting: Cannot see Worker logs or the EmailIt dashboard from the audit environment; the exact rejection reason needs the EmailIt send log for 06:48Z/06:51Z/07:21Z UTC.

feature: Sign up refused: "email rate limit exceeded" (project-wide auth email limit)
promise: Create a founders.click workspace and start a 14-day free trial (signup page)
expected: Account created; told to check email for a confirmation link (or land on /app)
actual: POST /auth/v1/signup → 429 {code:'over_email_send_rate_limit', message:'email rate limit exceeded'}; toast 'email rate limit exceeded'; the form stays on /signup and no account is created. Sequence in the preceding hour: 05:51 reset (accepted), 05:59:28 signup C (accepted), 05:59:36 reset (429), 06:06:36 signup D (429) — i.e. roughly 2 accepted auth emails per hour project-wide before every further signup and reset is refused. Same limit blocked the Outlook resend for ~50 min on 2026-09-01.
console_errors: error: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 429 ()
customer_impact: Beyond ~2 auth emails per hour across ALL customers, new signups and password resets are refused outright with a rate-limit error.
repro: trigger two auth emails (signups/resets) within an hour
attempt a third signup → 429 'email rate limit exceeded'
